translation.en:
Done in Konin on the Tuesday next before the Feast of Saint Francis the Confessor, namely on the third day of the month of October in the Year of the Lord 1775.

On behalf of the Heir of Trąbczyn — Boundary Survey Inspection

text_english:
Done in Konin on the Tuesday next before the Feast of Saint Francis the Confessor, namely on the third day of the month of October in the Year of the Lord 1775.

On behalf of the Heir of Trąbczyn — Boundary Survey Inspection
summary_en: The heading of an entry of 3 October 1775: for the heir of Trąbczyn, an inspection of the boundary line. The entry itself was not written.
summary_de: Überschrift eines Eintrags vom 3. Oktober 1775: für den Erbherrn von Trąbczyn, Besichtigung des Grenzzugs. Der Eintrag selbst wurde nicht geschrieben.
